b: I'm a cofounder at a B2B SaaS company that's still in its early stages, and growth is still mostly me. Over the last couple of months, I've noticed a lot of relevant people discussing pain points and vendor recommendations inside closed ecosystems. Slack groups and Discord servers mainly, but I'm sure there are other examples. Dark social, essentially.

The thing is, we absolutely do not have the internal bandwidth to manually monitor all of this. I have someone working on it, but they can only spend a few hours a week so I know qualified leads are slipping through the cracks.
I am wondering if there's a way to automate the monitoring here without being intrusive. I guess I'm not sure if it's even possible from a technical standpoint.
Has anyone solved this yet? How are you handling it?
